details:
I've noticed that you can rejoin on orange-status users when you've visited the instance that contains them once.
The bug persists until you restart the client. I haven't tested if it persists if the target user changes instances or not.
While this doesn't seem like a huge deal at face-value I can see it being a privacy concern in a situation where there was a populated instance that later cleared-out and all the users still in the instance are on orange and expect that nobody can just join on them.
Although that is possible to do with an API tool anyway (and that's why I would advise people to not do anything out of the ordinary in an instance that other people have visited -- people can rejoin if they know how. Heck you don't even need an external tool, if you think you might wanna rejoin an instance later you can just use the website to toss yourself an anchor), I still assume this is undesired behavior in the client.
Here is a video where I demonstrate it: https://youtu.be/phbwIM8Vl1Y
I was in my homeworld after starting the client, I looked at a user that I knew was parked in the instance I was about to join, and as expected I can't join him because he's orange. Then I actually go to the instance, then I go back to my homeworld -- now I can just click "Join Instance" of any orange user that was in the instance. This would allow me to rejoin it even hours later and even if all green/blue users have since exited.
Just figured I'd report it, thanks.
title: [1226] Users can rejoin on orange-status users after visiting an instance that contained them.
